minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, October 20, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 20, 2021.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Jenny Jolly, Bette Donovan and Scott
  Snider.
  Members absent: Lorraine Missick.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: YWCA, Christie Valenzuela, Healthy Aging Manager, April Williams
  and Ruth Villareal, Regional Coordinator
  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: An average of 83 meals were distributed per week in
  September for the Grab-n-Go meals.

3. Guest Speaker: Christie Valenzuela, YWCA, Mgr. Senior Nutrition, gave an update
  on meals distributed. It’s a County funded program through the Department of Aging
  and the Workforce Development Centers which does home delivered meals to home
  bound residents. They take orders from the county and in March 2020 they went to
  once a week delivery. They are re-evaluating how to best serve the community with
  the county. April is working on adding new aspects to meals program. They will give
  out goodie bags to participants and other special things to help. Ruth has been in
  charge of the frozen meal delivery for almost 2 years. Any suggestions for local
  vendors would be accepted. For the meals program age is a criteria to qualify. The
  suggested donation is $3.00 per meal. It is a county funded program and the City
  has a 12% match required. It’s funded under the Older Americans Act. At this
  moment there is no set date to start up the congregate meals.

4. Bingo Report: There is an average of 55-60 people per session with a lot of those
  being new participants. Financials are getting in order and they currently have 3
  callers. The new chair is in need of adjusting. The current Bingo balance is
  $3,926.75. Prize money is $50 per game and special game winning can be $70, $80
  and $100.

5. Meals on Wheels: Distributed 730 meals in September and a total of 1,111 for San
  Dimas and La Verne combined. La Verne recipients were 34 and the average meals
  per day was 50.5.
 6. Account Balance: $3,025.57

7. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid except Garden Friends.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: Registration will take place on November 3rd at 10:00 AM
  including Tai Chi classes.

9. Aging Next: Provided resources to 5 La Verne residents and delivered 4 meals.
  There is currently no case management.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Tuesday, October 26th –Health & Resource Fair, Community Center,
  9:00-11:00 AM
  th
  Friday, October 29 –Special Needs Dance, Community Center, 5:00-8:00 PM
  Saturday, October 30th –Downtown Trick or Treating, 2:00-5:00 PM
  Monday, November 1st – International Line Dancing, Basic Beginner
  1:00-2:00 PM and Cardio Beginner 2:00-3:00 PM
  Wednesday, November 3rd & 10th– Line Dancing, Beginner Class 2:00-3:00 PM
  and Intermediate Class 3:00-4:00 PM

11. Facilities Report: Preschool needs paint on a door. The curb adapters and sky lights
  are starting to crack at Veterans Hall. The Eagle Scouts added roses to the side of
  the building and the concrete is done. The craft room was repaired at the
  Community Center.

12. Public Comments: Yvonne announced that Frances will be 101 years old tomorrow.
  She is our oldest volunteer. The City Council will have a presentation pins on 11/1 to
  61 Military and 1 Eagle Scout. There will be prepackaged candy for Santa to pass
  out on Christmas. There will be on fire engine and fire trucks. 64 people have signed
  up so far for the Senior Dinner Dance which will serve Hawaiian BBQ for dinner.

  George gave a golf update about the 2nd round on Tuesday and the Club motion
  championships rap up in December. There will be a party in early November and
  present championships. George won the yearlong championship.

  Scott gave information from the Chamber of Commerce event. Taste of La Verne is
  tonight but not as many restaurants participated this year. The cost is $60 at the
  door and there are about 16-17 vendors. The event will be held at the airport.
 13. Adjourn: A motion was moved to adjourn the meeting at 11:15 AM, motion
  approved and carried. Next meeting will be held at the Community Center on
  November 17, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
